title: Kuragehime: Soreike! Amars Tankentai
justification: AniList 10391 (SPECIAL, 6 episode(s) from 2010-08-12) is AniDB 7531's special(s) S1-S6, aired 2010-08-12 to 2010-09-17. AniList's PARENT relation names the parent entry, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 7531. The parent node has no mapping rows, so S1-S6 default to TVDB 0x1-0x6.
